title: Zan-Sutos
summary: Zan-Sutos was the former ruler of Sutos Island and the father of Grier.

sections.heading: History
sections.wikitext:
Zan-Sutos ruled all of Sutos and was renowned as a wise and just leader. However, he eventually came to believe that his leadership was costing the people their freedom. He bravely gave up his own power so that his people could be free. Unfortunately, he was murdered by rioters. Instead of his son, Grier, the rightful heir, becoming ruler, Zan-Sutos was soon succeeded by [[Zan-Gason]].  {{source|Like Father, Unlike Son}}

[[Grier]] eventually returned to Sutos and, with the backing of [[the Organization]], seized control of the palace and returned to his rightful place as the Prince. He told the story of his father to the Huntik team, making them realise that while he may be from a rotten group, his intentions were honourable. {{source|Like Father, Unlike Son}}

full_text:
Zan-Sutos was the former ruler of Sutos Island and the father of Grier.

History

Zan-Sutos ruled all of Sutos and was renowned as a wise and just leader. However, he eventually came to believe that his leadership was costing the people their freedom. He bravely gave up his own power so that his people could be free. Unfortunately, he was murdered by rioters. Instead of his son, Grier, the rightful heir, becoming ruler, Zan-Sutos was soon succeeded by Zan-Gason.  [Like Father, Unlike Son]

Grier eventually returned to Sutos and, with the backing of the Organization, seized control of the palace and returned to his rightful place as the Prince. He told the story of his father to the Huntik team, making them realise that while he may be from a rotten group, his intentions were honourable. [Like Father, Unlike Son]

Abilities

As a member of the Sutos Island royalty, Zan-Sutos possessed the Amulet of the powerful Titan, Megataur.

Bonded Titans

• Megataur (formerly)
